canada.title: Nova Scotia Power’s $1 Billion Mortgage: How much should future ratepayers shoulder?
canada.summary: On a monthly power bill of $200, the annual increase would work out to $156.

canada.title: Alberta reducing need for sciences, humanities courses to graduate high school
canada.summary: The government's new requirements mean that students will only need to complete one senior level course in either English or social studies, while senior level math and science classes will still not be mandatory.

canada.title: N.S. backpedals on sports club 50/50 rule changes after pushback
canada.summary: The Nova Scotia government has reversed rule changes on how amateur sports clubs handle money raised through 50/50 raffles.

canada.title: Manitoban charged for allegedly forcing foreign workers to pay up to $30K for jobs
canada.summary: The general manager of a southern Manitoba business demanded cash payments — ranging from $10,000 to $30,000 — from foreign workers in exchange for employment, RCMP allege after a year-long investigation.

canada.title: Police make another arrest in connection with Montreal killing of crypto influencer
canada.summary: Kevin Mirshahi, 25, and three of his friends were kidnapped from a luxury condo in Old Montreal on June 21, 2024. Mirshahi's body was later found in a park in Montreal's Ahuntsic neighbourhood.

canada.title: 'Time is tissue': Woman spends weeks in Winnipeg hospital after post-surgery complications
canada.summary: A Winnipeg nurse says she's spent more than three weeks at Health Sciences Centre after a surgery to treat her chronic illness left her with gaping wounds, necrotic tissue and an infection. Emma Cloney had a skin-excision surgery to help treat lipedema on Oct. 20.

canada.title: 2 workers critically injured in collision on Pickering construction site: police
canada.summary: Two workers are critically injured after being struck by a driver on a construction site in Pickering, police say.

canada.title: New plan proposed for Moncton's crumbling Subway Block
canada.summary: Moncton's heritage board has given approval in principle to a proposal to rebuild the crumbling Subway Block, a part of the downtown landscape since 1917.

canada.title: 15 United Conservative constituency presidents won't sign agreement to publicly back Alberta referendum result
canada.summary: Presidents of 15 United Conservative Party constituency associations say they won’t sign a revised code of conduct requiring them to publicly respect and abide by the result of a provincial referendum on national unity.

canada.title: Court OKs class action alleging SQ discrimination against Indigenous people in Val-d’Or, Que.
canada.summary: The Quebec Superior Court has authorized the Val-d’Or Indigenous Friendship Centre to move forward with a class-action lawsuit against the Attorney General of Quebec, representing the Sûreté du Québec.

canada.title: Canadian government investing $200M in B.C.’s Woodfibre LNG
canada.summary: The Woodfibre LNG facility, near Squamish, will receive natural gas, cool it into liquefied natural gas, where it will be loaded onto specialized LNG carriers and exported overseas

canada.title: 2 dead, 1 missing after boating incident near Squamish, B.C.
canada.summary: Two people have died, and one person is missing after a boating incident in the Squamish Valley on Thursday.

canada.title: 70% of Inuit children live in households that skip meals, eat less to make ends meet: report
canada.summary: A new report on food access in Nunavut says the territory continues to be in a “food security crisis” and children are most affected.

canada.title: Province pulls licence for Living Sky Wildlife Rehab after Saskatoon non-profit fined in court
canada.summary: Living Sky Wildlife Rehabilitation's founder pleaded guilty to 'technical violations' but did not harm animals, court heard before issuing over $2,000 in fines.

canada.title: Aviation expert calls PAL Airlines wheel loss incidents unusual and 'disturbing'
canada.summary: McGill University aviation management expert John Gradek says PAL Airlines needs to seriously evaluate its maintenance practices after one of its aircraft lost a wheel — for the second time in two weeks.

canada.title: First Nations Leadership Council sends open letter to the prime minister, Indigenous Services over delay in passing Bill S-2
canada.summary: An open letter to Prime Minister Mark Carney and Indigenous Services Minister Mandy Gull Masty calls for an end to second-generation cut-off.

canada.title: Saskatchewan hospital safety review complete, but findings won’t be released yet
canada.summary: The six-month review is now in the health ministry's hands, but Health Minister Jeremy Cockrill says he does not want to expose vulnerabilities until they are addressed.

canada.title: Ontario Career college saw OSAP use rise by 6,000%, yet avoided funding cut off this spring
canada.summary: An Ontario career college with four campuses saw the amount of students receiving financial aid explode over a few years, including an increase of nearly 6,000 per cent at one campus, but it was not one of the schools the government cut off this spring.
